column1: # Part A functional validation: UniProt ligand name -> canonical PDB CCD id (for cross-source matching with BioLiP2)
# and ligand category. Hand-curated from the 40 most frequent experimental UniProt binding ligands (2026_03) and
# standard PDB CCD ids (rcsb.org/ligand/<id>). Category: metal | cofactor | small_molecule. CCD rows without a
# uniprot_name only assign a category to BioLiP2 CCD ids. Unlisted BioLiP regular ligands = small_molecule;
# BioLiP2 ligand_class 'metal' = metal; unlisted UniProt ligands keep their ChEBI id, category by name rule
